claim: A virtual private gateway can be attached to a single VPC, and you can attach one virtual private gateway to a VPC at a time. To connect the same Site-to-Site VPN connection to several VPCs, AWS recommends exploring a transit gateway instead.

evidence.quote: You can attach one virtual private gateway to a VPC at a time. To connect the same Site-to-Site VPN connection to multiple VPCs, we recommend that you explore using a transit gateway instead.
Virtual private gateway: A virtual private gateway is the VPN endpoint on the Amazon side of your Site-to-Site VPN connection that can be attached to a single VPC.
